name: mod-doctor
description: /mod-doctor checks your installed mods for outdated versions, conflicts and load errors.

repository.title: Repository
repository.description: GitHub owner/repo whose .claude-plugin/marketplace.json holds the latest versions.

branch.title: Branch
branch.description: Branch the catalog is read from.

readDebugLog.title: Read the debug log
readDebugLog.description: When the session runs with --debug, report hooks it skipped or trees it refused, per mod.

checkAtStart.title: Check at session start
checkAtStart.description: Run a quiet check when a session starts and toast new load errors or command clashes.
